title: Charlie Kirk: the story before the trial
subtitle: What we are entitled to believe while a capital case is still being tested
livingFileNotice: This is a Living Evidence File. It records process and public-narrative assessments at the cut-off date. It does not find guilt or motive. Judge Tony F. Graf's probable-cause / bind-over order (oral argument set 1 September 2026), any plea, trial record, or final judgment will enter the private dossier first and then this file with a changelog entry. If later evidence weakens a current finding, this file will say so.

overall.label: Event and charging process are KNOWN; guilt is not scored; drone-as-weapon is UNSUPPORTED
overall.confidence: Very high (process); object guilt not scored
overall.summary: Charlie Kirk was shot and later pronounced dead after speaking at a Turning Point USA event at Utah Valley University in Orem on 10 September 2025. That event frame is KNOWN. Utah authorities later charged Tyler James Robinson with aggravated murder and related counts and noticed intent to seek the death penalty. A public preliminary hearing was held 6–10 July 2026. As of 26 August 2026 the judge has not issued a probable-cause / bind-over order (oral argument set 1 September 2026). This file records what each layer of public knowing has earned. It does not adjudicate who did it or why. A later public-hypothesis market — military-drone-as-weapon, a HADES ISR jet's ADS-B track, Candace Owens first-hour timestamps, and the slogans 'the FBI is not investigating' / 'there is no evidence' — is scored separately. Drone-as-weapon is UNSUPPORTED. A public aircraft track near Utah Lake that day, if authentic, is only POSSIBLE as a transparency residual, not a kill-chain. 'FBI not investigating' is UNSUPPORTED as a blanket: Utah DPS said DPS and FBI co-led from day zero, and Utah County is prosecuting. 'No evidence at all' fails the charging record; court-tested evidence for the alternative theories has not been produced. Charge is not conviction. A preliminary-hearing exhibit is not a verdict.

claims.claim: Charlie Kirk was shot during a student-sponsored Turning Point USA event at Utah Valley University, Orem, at approximately 12:20 p.m. MST on 10 September 2025, transported to Timpanogos Regional Hospital, and later pronounced dead. Utah Department of Public Safety (DPS) and the FBI stated they were co-leading the investigation with the Utah County Attorney, County Sheriff, and local police. DPS described the shooting as believed to be a targeted attack — an official belief at T0, not a Ministry finding about the identity or motive of any shooter. This claim is an event frame. It is not a finding that Tyler James Robinson, or anyone else, is guilty.
claims.why: Utah DPS press release 10 September 2025 is the primary official pin. FBI 'Utah Valley Shooting Updates' and multi-source national press the same day independently report the death at the UVU event. Early persons of interest named and released in the DPS release are process history only.

claims.claim: On 16 September 2025, Utah County Attorney Jeff Gray filed a criminal information against Tyler James Robinson arising from Kirk's death. Publicly charged counts in that information path: aggravated murder (capital); felony discharge of a firearm causing serious bodily injury; two counts of obstruction of justice; two counts of witness tampering; violent offense in the presence of a child. These are allegations with legal form. Filing them is a process fact. It is not a conviction and not a Ministry finding that the allegations are true.
claims.why: Utah County Attorney charging page and the published Criminal Information PDF. Charging press coverage is secondary. Count-list residuals (later press '10 counts' versus the original seven) are not silently rewritten here.

claims.claim: As of the 26 August 2026 cut-off the case is in pre-trial probable-cause posture, not final judgment. A public preliminary hearing was held 6–10 July 2026 before Judge Tony F. Graf Jr. in the Fourth District Court, Provo. Under Utah procedure that hearing tests whether evidence establishes probable cause to bind the defendant over for trial — not guilt beyond reasonable doubt. The State filed a reply memorandum dated 18 August 2026 asking the court to bind over on all charged counts. Oral argument is set for 1 September 2026. No bind-over order had issued at cut-off. Hearing exhibits (campus video, roof items, DNA testimony, alleged admissions) are offered and contested evidence. They are not scored here as object facts.
claims.why: Public hearing coverage plus the 18 August 2026 State reply PDF. The pending order is the load-bearing residual. This file will update when the written PC ruling issues.

claims.claim: Prosecutors stated intent to seek the death penalty when charging Robinson. That is a charging-strategy process fact, not a finding about aggravators, and not a prediction of sentence.
claims.why: Gray charging announcement path, 16 September 2025. Formal notice-of-intent pin remains a residual; public intent is enough for this process claim at High confidence.

claims.claim: Public knowing in a live capital case has layers with different warrants: social media and viral clips; news reports; official law-enforcement statements; charging instruments; preliminary-hearing exhibits and testimony; judicial probable-cause orders; trial verdict / final judgment. Collapsing a lower layer into a higher one is the characteristic error of this specimen. Political sympathy for Kirk or hostility to him is not evidence. Defence wins on a motion are not global proof of innocence. Pre-trial publicity is process pressure, not a ledger upgrade.
claims.why: Method rule of the Ministry's Live File architecture (Chapter 19), applied to this record. Compatible with the nested-set warning in Bret Weinstein's 23 August 2026 DarkHorse conversation, which is cited as a public method exhibit, not as independent evidence of any object claim.

claims.claim: Whether Tyler James Robinson is guilty of killing Charlie Kirk, and what motive if any is proved, is UNKNOWN in this file until a final judgment (or equivalent finality) exists. The Ministry does not treat charging, contested preliminary-hearing items, or commentator certainty as a substitute. UNKNOWN is allowed to win here on purpose.
claims.why: Live File hard rule. Capital procedure exists because public certainty is a poor substitute for adversarial testing. A later verdict will be a changelog event, not a silent rewrite of C1–C5.

claims.claim: The claim that Kirk was killed by a military drone or UAV-fired munition, rather than by a rifle shot, is UNSUPPORTED on the harvested record. Public ADS-B of an aircraft, phone video of a fast object, and YouTube inference do not build the chain: track ≠ tasking ≠ launch ≠ courtyard drone ≠ fatal shot. The charging theory remains a rifle shot from the Losee Center roof (~142 yards / ~130 m in public LE and hearing coverage). July 2026 preliminary-hearing testimony offered line of sight from that roof, a screwdriver on the roof, and campus video of a figure going onto the roof and prone near 12:23 p.m. That is offered evidence, not a verdict. UVU not flying a security drone that day is a documented protective gap, not proof of a weapon drone.
claims.why: No court-tested UAV-munition chain harvested. Cullen/Dore advocacy (20 August 2026) is commentary. AP 30 September 2025 documents the absence of campus security drones. DarkHorse 23 August 2026 hosted the question; Viva Frei on that episode held a roof-bullet position. Hosting is not proof.

claims.claim: If public ADS-B/Flightradar overlays of a HADES-class ISR jet (registration discussed as N1098L) near Utah Lake on 10 September 2025 are authentic, the flight profile is a legitimate transparency residual: why was that aircraft low and slow adjacent to UVU, including a pass after the shooting? Correlation is not causation. Competing ordinary readings include a Provo Municipal straight-in / go-around and drone drop-and-recovery training. Tasking orders, crew manifests, and sensor logs, if they exist, are controlled records. Their absence is a provenance problem under the missing-evidence rule. It does not auto-complete to 'the aircraft launched the kill.'
claims.why: One public-data class (ADS-B aggregators as narrated by citizen investigators). Not independently re-downloaded as raw frames in this packaging pass — hence POSSIBLE, not KNOWN. Official explanation not harvested.

claims.claim: Candace Owens's public first-hour timestamp thread (July 2026 path: first public 'shot' post ~12:32 Utah time, Daily Mail ~12:34, Shapiro repost ~12:38, Andrew Kolvet text ~12:40) is KNOWN as her allegation set. It does not establish that named parties knew of the shooting before ~12:20 p.m. MST. Fast after-action calls among security details are the ordinary competing explanation (Shapiro later described his security on the phone with Kirk's security while Kirk was still in the car). Claims that Kirk's security chief Brian Harpole attended a Fort Huachuca planning meeting the day before are UNSUPPORTED in this criminal file and are the subject of a live federal defamation action: Harpole v. Owens, No. 3:26-cv-00556 (M.D. Tenn., filed 30 April 2026). That lawsuit is a process fact. It is not a finding that the meeting happened or that it did not.
claims.why: Owens's posts are primary as to what she claimed. Foreknowledge requires a clock before the shot. Civil complaint is the process pin for the Huachuca story. FOIA paraphrase fight with FBI Rapid Response (15 June 2026) is records process, cited under C10.

claims.claim: The blanket claims 'the FBI is not investigating' and 'there is no evidence' are UNSUPPORTED. DPS said on day zero that DPS and the FBI were co-leading. FBI published an updates page. Director Kash Patel testified that the Bureau released images, walked the scene on 11 September 2025, surged evidence-response assets, and called the investigation ongoing, including possible accomplices. Charging is a Utah County case, not a federal indictment harvested here. A FOIA dispute over Patel's travel itinerary is not proof the Bureau sat the case out. 'No evidence at all' fails the 16 September information and the July 2026 preliminary hearing. What has not been produced is court-tested evidence for the alternative theories (drone-weapon, Huachuca plot, Israeli operation). That gap is not proof those theories are true.
claims.why: DPS 10 September 2025 co-lead language; FBI updates page; Patel remarks / congressional testimony path; State bind-over reply 18 August 2026. Owens's 'non-existent case' slogan is commentary.

hypotheses.title: Wait for tested layers
hypotheses.status: Best supported for this file's job
hypotheses.text: The public is entitled to the event frame and to process facts (charges, hearing, pending PC). It is not entitled to treat pre-trial narrative as adjudicated truth.
hypotheses.test: Predicts charging documents, a public prelim, and a still-pending order as of 26 August 2026. Holds.

hypotheses.title: The public already knows who and why
hypotheses.status: Rejected as a Ministry object finding
hypotheses.text: Fast charging plus prelim exhibits settle guilt and motive.
hypotheses.test: Predicts a verdict or at least a PC order. Neither exists at cut-off. L3/L4 are not L6.

hypotheses.title: A military drone fired the fatal shot
hypotheses.text: HADES/ADS-B plus viral objects prove a UAV kill and imply a state or allied operation.
hypotheses.test: Predicts munition, launch, and a bridge from track to shot. Not produced. Roof-rifle theory is the charging theory.

hypotheses.title: The FBI is not investigating / there is no case
hypotheses.text: Federal inaction plus missing alternative-theory proof means the state case is theatre.
hypotheses.test: Predicts no FBI co-lead, no charging PDF, no prelim. Fails. Alternative-theory gaps remain real and separate.

hypotheses.title: First-hour timestamps prove a plot
hypotheses.text: Shapiro/security knew too fast; therefore the shooting was pre-known to insiders.
hypotheses.test: Requires a clock before 12:20 MST. After-action security calls can be fast. Huachuca story is in defamation litigation, not a criminal finding.

methodAudit.name: Grammar
methodAudit.note: Event death, charging, PC posture, death-penalty notice, method layers, object guilt, drone-weapon, ADS-B residual, Owens foreknowledge, FBI-absence slogan are separate claims. 'Charged' ≠ convicted. 'Targeted attack' in a DPS release is T0 belief. 'Drone' is not 'ISR jet nearby.' 'FOIA delay' is not 'no investigation.'

methodAudit.name: Logic
methodAudit.note: H-process-first is the file's job. H-already-know rejected as object finding. H-drone unsupported as established. H-fbi-sat rejected as blanket. H-owens-foreknowledge unsupported. Hidden premises blocked: after-action speed = plot; missing HADES logs = the jet fired; co-lead = federal authorship.

methodAudit.name: Rhetoric
methodAudit.note: Stripped: 'they got Charlie,' 'the FBI did it,' 'the case is fake,' 'science proved a drone.' Neutral: a public killing, a state capital case still in PC posture, and a loud alternative-hypothesis market that has not built its bridges. Identity-swap: same layers if victim and defendant politics were reversed.

methodAudit.name: Reality
methodAudit.note: Discriminators: DPS time/death; information PDF; five-day public prelim; bind-over brief dated 18 August with no order by 26 August; no UAV-munition exhibit harvested. Controls: protective-drone absence (AP) does not imply weapon-drone presence.

methodAudit.name: Independence
methodAudit.note: DPS, FBI page, charging PDF, hearing/bind-over brief are official process lines. Commentary is one market. ADS-B is one OSINT class. Do not count YouTube interviews as independent of the tracks they narrate.
